'''Thornshades''' is an [[:Category:Effects|Effect]] added in [[Version 1.10.0]]. It acts similarly to Thorns, reflecting a portion of melee damage back at the attacker.

Thornshades does not stack.

==Trivia==
* If one lets the Thornshades buff run out twice and drinks another Thornshade Decanter, they will explode and die, granting the {{AdvancementLink|Beautiful Self-Destruction}}.
